newsitem.title: USA: Six Cubans arrive by boat in Key Biscayne.
newsitem.headline: Six Cubans arrive by boat in Key Biscayne.

text.p: Six Cubans arrived in this upscale Miami suburb early on Wednesday after crossing illegally from the island in a boat, police and border patrol officials said.

Lt. Samuel Ceballos of the Key Biscayne police department said the three men, two women and a child reached Key Biscayne on an island near downtown Miami on Wednesday morning. They were picked up by a cab driver who took them to Oasis, a Cuban sandwich shop.
One of the women then went to a local hospital where she was treated for low blood pressure, Ceballos said.

He said the U.S. border patrol picked up the group at the restaurant for questioning. Border patrol officials said they could provide no immediate information on the group's whereabouts or how their immigration status might be handled.

The U.S. Coast Guard has returned more than 600 Cubans to the island in the past two years, most of whom were caught trying to cross the Florida Straits. But a spokesman said the agency was not involved with the group that arrived on Wednesday.
